evidence_items.locator: Section What can teams do?; underlying results in the preceding two sections
evidence_items.explanation: The March survey of 3,500 developers and managers found widespread reported time savings from generative AI alongside substantial time lost to organizational inefficiencies. Both findings directly fit benefits coexisting with important unresolved problems.

This randomized study found a 19% slowdown among experienced open-source developers despite their perceived speed gains. It cautions against treating survey estimates as measured productivity; it is context because the aggregate February–June study window cannot be confined to June 16 or earlier.
